name: Interview Evaluation Report
description: Comprehensive interview evaluation template covering candidate profile, competency scoring, question analysis, and hiring recommendation.

sections.title: Interview Metadata
sections.instruction: Extract or infer: Date, Time, Candidate Name, Position Applied For, Interviewer Name, Interview Duration, Interview Type (Technical/HR/Behavioral)

sections.title: Candidate Profile
sections.instruction: Brief summary of candidate's educational background, current role/status, years of experience, location, and key skills mentioned

sections.title: Competency Assessment
sections.instruction: Rate each relevant competency on a scale of 1-5 with evidence from the transcript. Include at least 5 competencies covering technical skills, problem solving, communication, domain knowledge, and leadership/teamwork

sections.title: Key Questions & Responses
sections.instruction: List each major question asked during the interview, summarize the candidate's response, and provide an assessment of how well they answered

sections.title: Technical Depth Analysis
sections.instruction: Evaluate the candidate's depth of technical knowledge. Mention specific technologies, frameworks, concepts they discussed and how well they explained them

sections.title: Projects & Experience Discussed
sections.instruction: List each project or experience the candidate discussed, including their role, technologies used, challenges faced, and outcome

sections.title: Communication & Soft Skills
sections.instruction: Evaluate the candidate's communication clarity, confidence level, ability to articulate complex ideas, and interpersonal demeanor during the interview

sections.title: Strengths & Weaknesses
sections.instruction: List key strengths and areas of concern observed during the interview

sections.title: Culture Fit & Motivation
sections.instruction: Assess how well the candidate aligns with team culture, their motivation for the role, career goals, and enthusiasm level

sections.title: Final Recommendation
sections.instruction: Provide a clear Hire / No Hire / Hold decision with a detailed rationale based on the evidence gathered during the interview

sections.title: Next Steps & Action Items
sections.instruction: List follow-up actions required such as second round scheduling, reference checks, technical assessments, or offer preparation
